assumptions: TraceTuner's mixed-base caller at the ratio given.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the called read and its mixed positions, which the outputs carry; the Recompute quality section shows them as a track to adopt and writes its reading only on adoption, which adopt_trace_calls returns.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does a second allele sit under the primary call?

description: Call the bases of a Sanger trace AND ask at every position whether a second allele is present, writing a two-base IUB code (R, Y, S, W, K, M) where it is. `mode: het` assumes the two alleles are present in equal amounts, which is the diploid heterozygote case; `mode: mix` assumes nothing about their ratio, for a mixed template, a contaminated read or a pooled sample. The two disagree: on this repo's own corpus they differ on 348 of 5,605 calls. Also returns the ALTERNATIVE calls the search considered and rejected.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

document.description: which trace to run on: a file name (`read_F.ab1`) or its project file id. Leave unset to use the trace tab on screen. A file id is project-specific, so a template ships this unset.

min_ratio.description: how tall a second peak must be, as a fraction of the called peak, before the search will consider it as a second allele. Lowering it widens what is considered, which is not the same as calling more mixed bases.

mode.description: het = the two alleles are assumed present 1:1 (a diploid heterozygote); mix = no assumption is made about their ratio.

table.description: the instrument/polymer calibration table to score against. The same signal scores differently under each, so a quality value is only interpretable with the table named. Defaults to ABI 3730 POP-7.

name: call_mixed_bases_from_trace

bases.description: how many bases the reading called

instrumentBases.description: how many the FILE carries, so a gate can see a de-novo reading change the read's length

meanQuality.description: the mean Phred of the reading, on the calibration table it names

mixedBases.description: how many positions were called as carrying two alleles. Reported as 0 rather than omitted when none were, because a missing field is not an answer
